mapper.insert: INSERT INTO owners ( name, phone, email, address, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{address}, false, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, CASE WHEN u.id IS NULL THEN false ELSE true END AS has_account FROM owners o LEFT JOIN users u ON o.id = u.owner_id WHERE o.deleted_at=false ORDER BY o.id DESC
SELECT o.id, o.full_name, o.phone, o.email, o.address FROM owners o WHERE o.id=#{id} AND o.deleted=false
SELECT * FROM owners WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=false
mapper.update: UPDATE owners SET full_name=#{fullName}, phone=#{phone}, email=#{email}, address=#{address}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, CASE WHEN u.id IS NULL THEN false ELSE true END AS has_account FROM owners o LEFT JOIN users u ON o.id=u.owner_id WHERE o.deleted=false AND ( o.full_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR o.phone LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') )
mapper.update: UPDATE owners SET deleted=true, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
